fields.description: Issue includes an exposé alleging misconduct by Dr. Earl Moore and urging investigation by medical licensing authorities; editorials and repeated ballot coupons opposing a proposed Florida sales tax and calling for a public vote; coverage of Miami Beach city government focusing on City Manager Claude Renshaw and alleged protection of a gambling syndicate; local court and policing items, including city court cases and allegations of vindictive enforcement; and regular features/columns plus health and real-estate guidance articles.
